resources.string: The app is always dark. This makes the backgrounds black instead of dark grey, which saves power on OLED screens.
The language of the app. The translations are part of the app; nothing is downloaded.

ultimateVE keeps its files in its own subfolder, called ultimateVE, inside the folder you choose (nothing is put loose in the folder itself). Footage that comes inside a LumaFusion package is copied to ultimateVE/Media, in one folder per project, so you can see and manage the files (a USB drive or SD card works too). Project backups (.uvbundle) open the file picker in ultimateVE/Project-Backups. Deleting a project never deletes these files.
